question: does NI(Delta) ever ACCEPT? Tested on the shallowest damage in the repository (7B, 16 of 32 layers, 200k heal steps), which is already scored on all four axes.
gpu_note: CPU-only re-analysis of per-example shards already on disk. Read-only ssh + scp -O to stage wzc1-only shards onto zwfy6. No model was loaded.

prereg.ni_definition: accept iff one-sided lower 95% bound on residual(arm)-residual(intact) > -Delta, Delta = 0.10*residual(intact); imported ni_rule, not reimplemented

intact_anchor.why: A04's 1B anchor (guard G0) is A03_1B_base, whose meta is mode=base / base_model=../models/OLMo-2-0425-1B -- the VANILLA base. The 7B analogue is therefore the vanilla OLMo-2-1124-7B, not full32_step25000, which is mode=pruned keep_front_layers=32 continued-pretrained on the heal corpus for 25k steps.
intact_anchor.full32_is_not_the_anchor: full32_step25000 is carried as an ARM (zero-damage control) and as a labelled diagnostic. Guard G2 forbids changing the anchor, so it can never alter a verdict.
